source_title: Brittany Mahomes' $117 million stadium project highlights her growing influence in women's soccer - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Brittany Mahomes is building a public identity that reaches far beyond the Kansas City Chiefs and her marriage to Patrick Mahomes. From investing in women's soccer to expanding her fitness and media profile, she has become an increasingly visible figure in the sports business world. Her latest activities in 2026 highlight that growing influence, while her personal updates have also attracted attention. Between motherhood, business ventures and health disclosures, Brittany continues to balance several parts of her life under the public spotlight.Brittany Mahomes expands her influence through women's sports and businessOne of Brittany Mahomes' biggest ventures remains her involvement with the Kansas City Current. She is a founding member and co-owner of the NWSL club, which was established in December 2020. Her interest in the team also reflects her own sporting background. Brittany played college soccer at the University of Texas at Tyler before spending a year competing professionally in Iceland.Her involvement has grown alongside the club's ambitions. The Current opened KC Current Studios at Current Landing in August 2026, creating space for original shows, podcasts, interviews and sports broadcasts. The facility also aims to help women interested in sports media through workshops and training programmes.Brittany's work has earned wider recognition. In May 2026, United WE presented her with its inaugural Champion for Change Award for her contributions to women's leadership and professional sports. She also joined the NWSL Advisory Board and entered the University of Texas at Tyler Athletics Hall of Fame.Beyond soccer, she has maintained her fitness business, which began with an online training programme in 2019. Her modelling career has also gained attention, including a February 2026 digital cover for Sports Illustrated Swimsuit.Brittany Mahomes shares personal and health updates in 2026Away from business, Brittany's family life remains an important part of her public profile. She and Patrick share three children, Sterling, Bronze and Golden, who was born in January 2025. Her social media presence often features family moments, fashion choices and appearances at Chiefs games.Her health has also become a subject of public interest. In March 2024, Brittany revealed that she had suffered a fractured back and encouraged women to pay attention to pelvic-floor health after pregnancy.More recently, in May 2026, she disclosed that she had been dealing with De Quervain's tenosynovitis, commonly known as mother's wrist, for around a year. The condition can cause pain around the thumb and wrist.These disclosures provide a clearer picture of the challenges she has discussed publicly.
